Continuous bilingual story audit

Continuous synthetic story WAV per run; native voices change at language boundaries; silent real-time WebAudio output; not human microphone testing.

Process-tree RSS sums include shared pages. CPU one-core percent can exceed 100. VRAM and utilization cover the whole GPU, including Windows/other apps. Sampled peaks are lower bounds. Stage peaks may have no samples for very short inference.

Every input is one continuous WAV containing a connected story. The reference text is used for scoring only. These synthetic voices do not establish human microphone accuracy.

Continuous input

Yesterday Anna and I travelled to Berlin for an interview. Am Bahnhof sagte sie, unser Zug fällt aus. We found a bus, but I said, bitte kaufe noch keine Tickets. Then the company called. The interview was at ten, not nine. Wir kamen um neun Uhr fünfundvierzig an. Please summarize what happened in two sentences.

        {
